adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` with `update`/`destroy` that do `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy`. If the record doesn’t exist, `host` is `nil`, leading to `NoMethodError` on `host.host = ...` or `host.destroy` (500 instead of 404). Additionally, `save_host` assumes `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` exists; if `params[:embeddable_host]` or `:host` is missing, it will raise `NoMethodError`/`TypeError`. Finally, the model `before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!` without guarding against `self.host` being `nil`, so missing host params also produce a 500 during validation. All are verifiable from the added code paths.
